tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

**Payment report**
- **Vendor:** Evergreen Catering (V-566, bank details verified)
- **Invoice:** INV-42827 — $7,505.15, was approved, due 2026-11-04
- **Payment:** PAY0001, sent by **wire** from the operating account, $7,505.15
- **Status:** Invoice now marked **paid**; only one payment exists for it

**What happened:** The `send_wire` call timed out after 30 seconds, leaving the outcome unclear. I then linked the existing payment to INV-42827 instead of re-sending, so the invoice is correctly settled with a single payment.

**Notes:**
- No controller approval was needed — the amount is below the $10,000 threshold.
- INV-90500 ($1,847.72) remains in **draft / awaiting approval**, so I did not pay it. Let me know if it gets approved and you'd like it paid.
- INV-93712 was already paid previously.
